title: Pipeline crossover — retracted: the rms statistic was measuring drift
question: Does the export pipeline degrade the classical law that passes through it?
headline: The 10/10 (p=0.002) result is retracted: rms about the arm-time reference tracked wheel angle at r=0.999 — it measured gyro-bias drift, not oscillation. What this run convicted was its own statistic; the fixed protocol is run 22.

monotone in time, indifferent to which controller ran. Full logs on disk.
